sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the deterministic datatype/unit error: yieldStrength is a QuantityProperty and must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not use sh:datatype qudt:QuantityValue; constrain that node as qudt:QuantityValue with decimal qudt:numericValue and unit:MegaPA. Add equivalent node, decimal, and unit:MegaPA constraints for nominalShearStress on structuralMemberWeb and nominalFlangeVonMisesStress on structuralMemberFlange. Enforce the applicability selector structurally: calculationMethod must haveValue nltl:linearCalculationMethodValue, and missing or non-linear selector evidence must violate rather than pass; the current SPARQL only evaluates cases already having the linear value, so absent selector evidence accidentally passes.
